declaration.text:
ramify 1
module ledger

// One flushed append is one transaction; record files are materialized copies
// of the log; an external effect goes from intent to completion under a key.
expose-src Ledger, LedgerEntry, RecordSchema, openLedger, OpenLedgerOptions, Transaction, RecordBody, RecordRead, LedgerCorruptError, maximumLineBytes from "ledger.ts" to parent
expose-src EffectSpec, PendingEffect from "effects.ts" to parent
expose-src LedgerFileSystem, LedgerFileHandle, LedgerOpenFlags, nodeFileSystem from "fs.ts" to parent
expose-src writeFileAtomic, writeFileExclusive, syncDirectory, ExclusiveWrite from "atomic.ts" to parent
expose-src JsonLines, CorruptJsonLinesError, readJsonLines, appendJsonLine, withJsonLineAppender, discardPartialLine from "jsonl.ts" to parent
